choices.A: A tangent to a circle is perpendicular to any radius of the circle
choices.B: A tangent to a circle is perpendicular to the radius through the point of tangency
choices.C: Every line passing through a point on a circle is perpendicular to the radius through that point

question: Which of the following statements about the properties of tangents to a circle is correct?
solution: A tangent is perpendicular to the radius through the point of tangency, not to every radius. A line passing through a point on a circle is not necessarily a tangent; for example, the line joining that point to the center is not perpendicular to the radius. Therefore the correct choice is B.
